name: The Second Gate
description: Another doorway, out past the salt, that nobody sweeps.
arrival: The same build as the Gate Court and none of the care: a frame of dressed basalt in a field of it, half-drifted with salt, and no path worn to it. It is not doing anything today.
notes: **The gates are plural, and canon always said so.** `event_shadow_pact` and `event_asura_synapsid_domestication` both say "a Dwarka Gate", indefinite, and nothing has ever named a second one. This is that -- and the contrast is the point: one gate is swept municipal infrastructure, and this one is a door in a field that everybody has agreed to stop walking to.
